about: Six avatar character ideas to pick from or mix. Drawn as T-pose construction drawings for Tripo; on stream the app frames them shoulders-up.
style: Fun, charming mascot style like a polished stylized 3D game character: smooth chunky shapes, bold readable silhouette, appealing colours.

props.subject: the Death Muffin mascot, a chubby little necromancer whose head is a dark chocolate muffin with a soft domed muffin top, wearing a small tattered dark purple hooded cloak pushed back behind the muffin top, a paper cupcake-wrapper skirt over stubby legs, a tiny bone skull charm and a little bronze bell on its belt, small purple accents, bright purple eyes; cute and a bit spooky, never scary

a cute boxy little robot whose head is an old rounded TV with a screen for a face (the eyes and mouth are drawn on the screen), chunky rounded body and limbs, a short antenna with a ball on top, teal and cream colours with orange details
a chill green frog wearing an oversized orange hoodie with the hood down, baggy grey shorts and chunky sneakers
a playful fox spirit (kitsune) with fluffy orange fox ears and one big fluffy white-tipped tail, wearing a short white and red shrine-style jacket, dark shorts and sandals
a little mushroom wizard whose head is a big red mushroom cap with white spots, wearing a cozy blue robe with gold star patterns, a rope belt with a small pouch, and little boots
a small cat knight in chunky shiny silver armour with a short red cape, an open-faced helmet with the cat ears poking out through it, grey tabby fur
